SiteA ↔ SiteB API Integration Guide

This document explains the simplest recommended way for SiteA to integrate with SiteB (driver app + backoffice), including order creation, cancellation, driver callbacks, urgent price updates, and JWT-based authentication.

SiteA = Main website SiteB = Driver app + Backoffice Auth = JWT bearer token Transport = JSON over HTTPS

Current working values

SiteA callback domain

https://macau-ledger.vercel.app

Shared secret

rsbh5ksO46Xn4E4ziPLg0HJI2sFjY_XH6QRAiJBUonSLVLlnvhE7s50CBVDvRCnH
SiteB base URL is your deployed backoffice domain. Replace {SITEB_BASE_URL} in the examples below with that real deployed URL, for example your Vercel backoffice domain.

Integration model

SiteA → SiteB

Create orders, cancel orders before pickup, increase incentive amount, and optionally query order status.

SiteB → SiteA

Send callbacks when the driver accepts, picks up, arrives, completes with proof, or reports an exception.

Use SiteA external order id as the shared reference key across both systems. This should be unique per order and never reused.

Authentication

SiteA first asks SiteB for a JWT token. SiteA then sends that token in the `Authorization: Bearer ...` header for all API calls.

POST /api/v1/auth/token

Purpose: allow SiteA to obtain a short-lived token to call SiteB securely.

{
  "clientId": "sitea-production",
  "clientSecret": "rsbh5ksO46Xn4E4ziPLg0HJI2sFjY_XH6QRAiJBUonSLVLlnvhE7s50CBVDvRCnH",
  "audience": "siteb-api"
}
{
  "accessToken": "<jwt>",
  "tokenType": "Bearer",
  "expiresIn": 3600
}
Recommended: keep token lifetime short, for example 1 hour. SiteA should cache it and refresh it before expiry.

Real curl example

curl -X POST "{SITEB_BASE_URL}/api/v1/auth/token" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "clientId": "sitea-production",
    "clientSecret": "rsbh5ksO46Xn4E4ziPLg0HJI2sFjY_XH6QRAiJBUonSLVLlnvhE7s50CBVDvRCnH",
    "audience": "siteb-api"
  }'

Copy-paste working examples

These examples follow the API routes that are already implemented in SiteB now.

1. Get token

curl -X POST "{SITEB_BASE_URL}/api/v1/auth/token" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "clientId": "sitea-production",
    "clientSecret": "rsbh5ksO46Xn4E4ziPLg0HJI2sFjY_XH6QRAiJBUonSLVLlnvhE7s50CBVDvRCnH",
    "audience": "siteb-api"
  }'

2. Create order

curl -X POST "{SITEB_BASE_URL}/api/v1/orders" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "externalOrderId": "A-REAL-TEST-0001",
    "pickupMode": "now",
    "deliveryMode": "scheduled",
    "deliveryDeadline": "2026-07-04T22:30:00+08:00",
    "deliveryFeeMop": 42,
    "urgent": true,
    "currency": "MOP",
    "shop": {
      "externalShopId": "SITEA-SHOP-001",
      "name": "Cafe Lisboa",
      "address": "Rua do Campo, Macau",
      "latitude": 22.1984,
      "longitude": 113.5439,
      "contactName": "Counter",
      "contactPhone": "+85328991234"
    },
    "customer": {
      "externalCustomerId": "SITEA-CUS-001",
      "name": "Chan Tai Man",
      "phone": "+85366112244",
      "address": "Taipa Central Garden",
      "latitude": 22.1567,
      "longitude": 113.5581,
      "deliveryNote": "Call upon arrival"
    },
    "items": [
      { "name": "Baked Pork Chop Rice", "quantity": 1 },
      { "name": "Lemon Tea", "quantity": 2 }
    ],
    "notes": {
      "shopNote": "Pickup from cashier",
      "driverNote": "Keep drinks upright"
    },
    "callback": {
      "url": "https://sitea.example.com/api/integration/delivery/siteb/callback",
      "headers": {
        "X-SiteA-Key": "sitea-demo-key"
      }
    }
  }'

3. Raise price

curl -X POST "{SITEB_BASE_URL}/api/v1/orders/A-REAL-TEST-0001/raise-price" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "newDeliveryFeeMop": 55,
    "reason": "rush_order",
    "updatedAt": "2026-07-04T19:10:00+08:00"
  }'

4. Cancel order

curl -X POST "{SITEB_BASE_URL}/api/v1/orders/A-REAL-TEST-0001/cancel" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "reason": "shop_owner_self_delivery",
    "requestedBy": "shop_owner",
    "requestedAt": "2026-07-04T19:12:00+08:00"
  }'

5. Query status

curl "{SITEB_BASE_URL}/api/v1/orders/A-REAL-TEST-0001" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {ACCESS_TOKEN}"

Order lifecycle

Stage Triggered by Direction Meaning
`new` Shop owner creates delivery request SiteA → SiteB Visible on driver home page as a ticket available to take.
`accepted` Driver taps `接單` SiteB → SiteA Driver has claimed the job and is going to the shop.
`picked_up` Driver confirms pickup at shop SiteB → SiteA Order has left the shop and is on the way to the customer.
`arrived` Driver reaches customer destination SiteB → SiteA Driver has arrived at customer location.
`delivered` Driver uploads proof of arrival/completion SiteB → SiteA Order is completed and callback includes proof image link.
`canceled` Shop owner cancels before pickup SiteA → SiteB Driver can no longer take the job.
`exception_reported` Driver reports abnormal case SiteB → SiteA Customer unreachable, accident, return order, delay, or other issue.
`urgent` Shop owner increases incentive SiteA → SiteB Order should display urgent priority on the driver app.

Cancel order before pickup

POST /api/v1/orders/{externalOrderId}/cancel

This should only succeed if the driver has not confirmed pickup.

{
  "reason": "shop_owner_self_delivery",
  "requestedBy": "shop_owner",
  "requestedAt": "2026-07-04T18:15:00+08:00"
}

Raise delivery incentive

POST /api/v1/orders/{externalOrderId}/raise-price

This increases driver incentive and marks the ticket as urgent in the driver app.

{
  "newDeliveryFeeMop": 55,
  "reason": "rush_order",
  "updatedAt": "2026-07-04T18:18:00+08:00"
}

Recommended extra API

GET /api/v1/orders/{externalOrderId}

This is not strictly required, but it is extremely useful for SiteA support staff and SiteB backoffice debugging.

SiteB to SiteA callbacks

All callbacks should include the order id, timestamp, current status, and any status-specific data.

Driver accepts order

POST {SiteA callback URL}
{
  "eventType": "order.accepted",
  "externalOrderId": "A-20260704-0001",
  "status": "accepted",
  "eventTime": "2026-07-04T18:22:00+08:00",
  "driver": {
    "name": "測試騎手 63936541",
    "phone": "+85363936541",
    "distanceToShopKm": 1.6,
    "etaMinutes": 6
  },
  "pickupTime": "2026-07-04T18:22:00+08:00"
}

Driver confirms pickup at shop

{
  "eventType": "order.picked_up",
  "externalOrderId": "A-20260704-0001",
  "status": "picked_up",
  "eventTime": "2026-07-04T18:31:00+08:00",
  "driver": {
    "name": "測試騎手 63936541",
    "phone": "+85363936541"
  }
}

Driver arrives at customer location

{
  "eventType": "order.arrived",
  "externalOrderId": "A-20260704-0001",
  "status": "arrived",
  "eventTime": "2026-07-04T18:46:00+08:00"
}

Driver completes with proof

{
  "eventType": "order.delivered",
  "externalOrderId": "A-20260704-0001",
  "status": "delivered",
  "eventTime": "2026-07-04T18:48:00+08:00",
  "proof": {
    "imageUrl": "https://siteb-storage.example.com/delivery-proofs/order-xxx.jpg",
    "uploadedAt": "2026-07-04T18:48:00+08:00"
  }
}

Driver reports abnormal case

{
  "eventType": "order.exception_reported",
  "externalOrderId": "A-20260704-0001",
  "status": "exception_reported",
  "eventTime": "2026-07-04T18:40:00+08:00",
  "exception": {
    "reason": "customer_unreachable",
    "action": "return_to_shop",
    "note": "Customer did not answer phone after multiple attempts."
  }
}

Required fields

Field Required Why it matters
`externalOrderId` Yes Main cross-system reference key.
`shop.address`, `shop.latitude`, `shop.longitude` Yes Needed for navigation and driver distance calculation.
`customer.address`, `customer.latitude`, `customer.longitude` Yes Needed for delivery navigation and arrival confirmation.
`deliveryFeeMop` Yes Shown to the rider so they know the payout.
`pickupMode`, `deliveryMode` Yes Allows `now` or scheduled logic without guessing from null timestamps.
`callback.url` Yes Required for SiteB to notify SiteA of driver actions.
`urgent` Recommended Lets the rider app visually prioritize the ticket.
`items[]` Recommended Useful for rider confirmation and support troubleshooting.

Recommended API rules

  • Every request should send `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`.
  • Use `externalOrderId` as an idempotency key. Repeating the same create request should not duplicate the order.
  • Every callback should contain `eventType`, `status`, and `eventTime`.
  • SiteA should return `200 OK` immediately after receiving a valid callback.
  • If SiteA is temporarily down, SiteB should retry callback delivery and log every attempt in backoffice.
  • Proof image should be returned as a URL, not as raw image binary in JSON.

What changes in the current app and backoffice

Driver app

  • Home page becomes the live ticket board for `new` orders.
  • Driver needs `accept`, `pickup`, `arrived`, `delivered`, and `exception` actions.
  • Urgent price raise should visually mark the card.
  • Proof-of-delivery image must be uploaded and stored on SiteB.

Backoffice

  • Must show inbound API orders from SiteA.
  • Must show callback delivery logs and retry status.
  • Should support manual callback retry when SiteA fails.
  • Should display exception reports and proof image links for support staff.
One extra API that is highly recommended is a status query endpoint, because it makes reconciliation much easier when SiteA and SiteB disagree about an order state.

Suggested endpoint list

Method Endpoint Direction Purpose
POST/api/v1/auth/tokenSiteA → SiteBGet JWT token
POST/api/v1/ordersSiteA → SiteBCreate delivery ticket
POST/api/v1/orders/{externalOrderId}/cancelSiteA → SiteBCancel before pickup
POST/api/v1/orders/{externalOrderId}/raise-priceSiteA → SiteBIncrease incentive
GET/api/v1/orders/{externalOrderId}SiteA → SiteBQuery latest state
POST{callback.url}SiteB → SiteAAccepted / picked up / arrived / delivered / exception
